sources.excerpt: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, with his son Howard Graham Buffett replacing him.
Greg Abel succeeded Buffett as CEO at the beginning of 2026.

The Bank of Japan raises its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 1.25%, the highest level since 1995, citing inflation pressures from rising energy costs and a weak yen, and signals further increases.

The 16th-century Codex Azcatitlan goes on display in Mexico City after France loaned two folios nearly two centuries after the manuscript left the country. Mexico continues seeking the codex's permanent return from France.
The Codex Azcatitlan is an Aztec codex detailing the history of the Mexica and their migration journey from Aztlán to the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire.
In the Bibliothèque nationale de France, where it is housed, it is known as Histoire mexicaine, [Manuscrit] Mexicain 59–64.
A record 90 chicks have been added to New Zealand's kakapo population this year, raising hopes that the critically endangered parrots can bounce back from the brink of extinction.
The kakapo, which lives only in New Zealand, is the world's heaviest parrot, topping the scales at up to nine pounds.
On September 1, New Zealand's Department of Conservation shared the latest tally: 325 kakapo individuals.
